decision: CONDITIONAL: v2 becomes the recommended ranking signal ONLY when the battery's operating protocol is represented in training data (LOBO-refit rho=0.841, p<0.001). It must NOT be used for an unseen protocol, where its ranking collapses to rho=-0.295 — statistically indistinguishable from noise and pointing the wrong way. v1 REMAINS the pipeline default because it needs no cohort label, but v1's own ranking is itself non-significant and negative (rho=-0.269), so it is retained as a transparent threshold-alerting heuristic and must not be presented as a validated fade ranking.
